description: Golden fixtures for Log Correlation. Each case is an incident (service + window) and the expected rule-based evidence: top error signature(s) and the suspect component. Assertions target only the DETERMINISTIC fields (service, top_signatures, suspected_dependencies, confidence) — not the LLM summary, which is non-deterministic for non-stub providers. Cases assume the offline/synthetic-signal path (no cluster up), which is the CI contract; with a live Loki/Jaeger/Prometheus the signatures reflect real data instead.

cases.description: product-catalog slow (self-injected GetProduct delay). Delay is inside the service boundary -> suspect is the service itself.
cart service RPC failures (cartFailure flag). Self-injected -> suspect cart.

expected.top_signatures_contains: CartService RPC failed: could not retrieve cart

cases.description: payment charge failures (paymentFailure flag). Self-injected -> suspect payment.

classification.probable_root_cause: payment service returning errors on charge

expected.top_signatures_contains: Payment charge failed: payment service unavailable

cases.description: checkout failing because its downstream payment dependency is erroring. Topology-aware join -> suspect is the dependency (payment), NOT checkout.
recommendation cache failure -> memory climbing. Self-internal -> suspect recommendation.

expected.top_signatures_contains: Recommendation cache miss storm; memory climbing

cases.description: ad service high CPU / GC pauses. Self-internal -> suspect ad.

expected.top_signatures_contains: AdService high CPU / manual GC pauses

cases.description: currency conversion failing (pod kill). Self-internal -> suspect currency.
A service with no catalog entry still produces a valid evidence pack (generic error signal, suspect = the service itself).
